thread:
maya: Quick heads-up: external pentest planned week of 2024-06-10. Need RBAC freeze window, minimal staging readroom, KMS access policy for assessors, and auditable log export. Scope: hosted API, Dedicated control plane, Console.

jamie: Proposed freeze: 2024-06-08T00:00Z -> 2024-06-12T23:59Z. Emergency changes only via ops-oncall with two-person signoff.

rachel: KMS plan: create ephemeral principal `pt_readroom` with kms:Decrypt limited to arn:aws:s3:::pt-evidence/artifacts/* and CloudTrail ReadOnly. Will post IAM & key-policy diff.

ops-oncall: Ops will disable autoscale-out for public endpoints during window and apply rate-limits. Alert suppression tag `pt-noise-20240610` enabled. Rollback snippets ready.

jamie: Remediation tracking: one JIRA epic PT-0624-REM and per-finding tickets. Each ticket needs PoF steps, before/after log query, and deploy timestamp. Retest opens 72h after ops+sec validation.

maya: Audit export: snapshot CloudTrail + app-audit stream, gpg-sign bundle, sha256 in manifest, upload to evidence bucket with 1y retention flag. Rachel please run dry-run and post sample tarball.

rachel: Dry-run sample logs (will attach real file):
2024-05-28T11:02:04Z account=123456 event=Encrypt key=pt-key principal=serviceA req=aaa
2024-05-28T11:02:15Z account=123456 event=Decrypt key=pt-key principal=pt_readroom req=bbb
sha256: d4c3...7f8

assessor-bot: Checklist link uploaded. Assessor requires key-policy diff, IAM diff, log tarball, and one sample query per finding. Schedule scoping call after uploads.

maya: Timeline: kickoff Fri Jun 2 10:00 PT. Deliverables by Tue May 28: PRs, dry-run tarball, and JIRA epic. Ping this thread for blockers.
